title: CT scan of the abdomen with contrast
what: A CT scan shows the organs in your belly in thin slices. Contrast dye given into a vein makes blood vessels and organs easier to see.
why: For belly pain, to look for tumors or stones, after an injury, and to check how treatment is working.
duration: 15 to 30 minutes in the scan room, sometimes longer if you need to drink contrast first
tell_doctor: Allergies, especially to iodine or contrast dye
Kidney disease. You may need a blood test for kidney function, called creatinine
Diabetes and diabetes medicines. The doctor will say if anything needs to change
If you are or might be pregnant

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no food for 4 to 6 hours. Water is fine. Your clinic will give you the exact time.

prepare.title: Contrast drink
prepare.text: Sometimes you are asked to drink a contrast liquid 1 to 2 hours before the scan. If so, come early.

prepare.title: Metal
prepare.text: Wear clothes with no metal around your belly. You will remove belts and jewelry.

bring: Your creatinine blood test, if you were asked for one
Past CT, MRI, or ultrasound scans
steps: A thin tube called a cannula is put into a vein in your arm
You lie on the table with your arms above your head
The table moves through a wide ring. The first scans are without contrast
When asked to breathe in and hold, you hold your breath for a few seconds
The contrast is given, and more scans are taken
feel: When the contrast goes in, you may feel a warm wave through your body, a metal taste, or a feeling that you need to pee. This is normal and passes in about a minute
after: The cannula is removed. You may be asked to wait at the clinic for 15 to 30 minutes
Drink extra water that day, unless your doctor says otherwise
The report usually comes in 1 to 2 days
red_flags: Itching, rash, a swollen face, or trouble breathing: tell staff right away, or call emergency services if you are already home

faq.q: How much radiation is in a CT scan?
faq.a: More than a regular X-ray, but the dose is set for the task. When the scan is medically needed, the benefit is greater than the risk.

reminders.text: CT scan with contrast in 6 hours. If your clinic asked, stop eating now. Water is fine.
CT scan soon. Bring your creatinine test and past scans.
